messages:
ana_cs: Lumin onboarding — Electron wrapper keeps spamming handshake, getting 429s during dev ramp. They see ~300 concurrent OPTIONS/POSTs. Logs attached? Anyone seen this pattern in electron embeds? :frowning_face:

devon_engineer: can you paste the raw headers + small log snippet

ana_cs: here's header: `OPTIONS /v1/chat HTTP/2` `Origin: https://app.lumin.local` `authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>` `x-client-v: electron/1.2.0` plus repeated `Connection: keep-alive` spikes

kevin_sdk: electron + service worker + background reconnect often causes duplicate preflights. Are they opening a new webview per window?

ana_cs: yes, they said each window spawns a new webContents and our JS SDK calls `init()` on focus

maria_support: :rotating_light: onboard-bot triggered rate-limit alert for account `lumin-team` (count 312)

devon_engineer: ask them to set SDK opt `{prefetch: false, keepAlive: true}` and enable jittered backoff. Also change ephemeral token TTL to 30s? hmm

kevin_sdk: no, increase TTL won't help. Better: reuse one socket across windows with `Redwood.connect()` singleton. Or set preflight coalescing: `sdk.config.coalescePreflight = true`

ana_cs: they can't refactor quickly. Any quick server-side toleration? We can temporarily raise their per-account preflight quota for 24h.

maria_support: I can file a short-term quota bump. Need approval idempotent note in ticket.

devon_engineer: meanwhile, suggest client-side patch: backoff code snippet:

`````
function jitterBackoff(attempt){ return Math.min(30000, (1000 * Math.pow(2, attempt)) + Math.random()*500) }
`````

Also check their token minting pattern — if they mint per window that will fan out JWKS fetches.

kevin_sdk: also check that their CI isn't rapidly rotating keys. If JWKS fetches happen per token rotation it'll cause stampede.

ana_cs: Lumin says they rotate keys every 20s in dev tests. probably the root cause.

maria_support: plan: 1) issue 24h quota bump 2) ask them to disable key rotation & use a singleton dev token 3) provide code snippet to de-dupe init 4) follow up tomorrow

devon_engineer: I'll add a small monitor to catch OPTIONS/min and alert if >100/min

ana_cs: thanks. I'll send the patch and update customer. :thumbsup:

onboard-bot: ticket #CS-2321 created, assignee: maria_support, severity: medium, note: temporary quota + customer-guidance

ana_cs: will close thread after confirmation tomorrow.
